rule: A gap closes only with a new native or browser observation saved under acceptance/. Static code and installed state never close a gap.

gaps.title: Native MCP Manager operations and safe financial delegation are unavailable
gaps.blockedBy: No shipped Manager package or public delegation contract that preserves the exact originating Agent, tool approval and monotonic floor.
gaps.notClaimed: Manager pass, commercial source access, OAuth
gaps.nextStep: Obtain a public delegation contract, or keep the documented compatibility boundary.

gaps.title: Authoring and byte delivery work; workspace write and recalculation are blocked
gaps.blockedBy: Bytes can now reach the caller over Remote, but ctx.fs still has no binary write and the confined subprocess still fails.
gaps.notClaimed: Bytes written into the workspace, recalculated workbooks, a verified browser download
gaps.nextStep: A person clicks the download control; the host still needs a binary write for workspace delivery.

gaps.title: Ten native business runs with licensed data have not been executed
gaps.blockedBy: No licensed commercial data entitlement; Office channel blocked as above.
gaps.notClaimed: Any business E2E or commercial output
gaps.nextStep: Run per-business inputs once data or Office delivery becomes available.

gaps.title: Services mount after an application restart; byte-equality of the review document across restarts is not yet measured
gaps.blockedBy: The restart happened, but no pre-restart snapshot of the review document was taken for that exact restart, so equality cannot be asserted.
gaps.notClaimed: Byte-identical recovery across an application restart
gaps.nextStep: Take a projection snapshot, restart, and compare the revision and totals.

gaps.title: The workbench, review panel, download and narrow layout were confirmed by a person
gaps.blockedBy: None for these four items; the remaining UI surfaces are tracked separately.
gaps.notClaimed: Settings pages, lifecycle UI, screen-reader output, formal contrast
gaps.nextStep: Closed for the observed scope; other UI gaps stay open.

gaps.title: Deliverables now offer the native open-session action; the click itself is unverified
gaps.blockedBy: A person must refresh the page, open a deliverable's session and confirm the switch.
gaps.notClaimed: Verified navigation, or opening the file itself
gaps.nextStep: Perform UI-5 and record the outcome.

gaps.title: UI behaviour across install, upgrade, disable, reinstall is unverified
gaps.blockedBy: Requires driving the Plugin Manager and the browser together.
gaps.nextStep: Record each lifecycle step in the manual checklist.

gaps.title: Narrow layout, dark theme readability and focus visibility were observed; screen-reader output and formal contrast were not
gaps.blockedBy: Screen-reader announcement and measured contrast still need a dedicated review.
gaps.nextStep: Run a screen reader and measure contrast tokens.

gaps.title: Diagnostic codes are stored and projected; per-business source lineage is missing
gaps.blockedBy: Stage records carry whitelisted codes only; no source or adapter grouping exists yet.
gaps.nextStep: Group codes by source and adapter once business runs exist.

gaps.title: The bundle configuration and activation views were never opened
gaps.blockedBy: The slots are registered but no one has opened the plugin detail page.
gaps.notClaimed: Settings page rendering, edit and save behaviour
gaps.nextStep: Open the bundle page and record what the configuration view shows.

gaps.title: An offline or permission-denied UI case was not run in the browser
gaps.blockedBy: Needs a deliberately broken connection or denied Remote while the page is open.
gaps.nextStep: Block the Remote and observe the degraded panels in the browser.
